t: You're at Waterloo Place, where a Banksy statue was installed in 2026. It shows a man in a suit stepping off his plinth while holding a large flag in front of him. The wind blows it back into his face, blinding him as he goes. Commentators have noted that it stands near monuments to British imperialism, including the statue of Edward VII and the Crimean War Memorial. Banksy is the anonymous street artist known for satirical, politically charged work, and has never publicly confirmed their identity.
